'''Limonium multiflorum''' is a species of [[Limonium|sea-lavender]] [[endemic]] to central-west [[Portugal]], where it inhabits rocky and sandy areas.

==Description==
Flowers are {{convert|6.3|-|7.2|mm|abbr=on}} in diameter and petals are purplish-reddish.<ref>{{cite web |title=68. L. multiflorum |url=http://www.floraiberica.es/floraiberica/texto/pdfs/03_055_04_Limonium.pdf |publisher=[[Flora Iberica]] |access-date=16 September 2021 |page=96}}</ref>
